create.name: Susan Piver
create.bio:
Susan Piver is a Buddhist meditation teacher and writer whose practice has its roots in the Nyingma school of Tibetan Buddhism, where her principal guide has been Tulku Thondup Rinpoche. She began meditating in 1993, took refuge two years later, completed a Buddhist seminary programme in 2004 and was authorised to teach meditation the following year. In the early 2010s she started the Open Heart Project, an online sangha that has grown to many thousands of members around the world.

She teaches meditation as a spiritual path rather than a self-improvement technique, and applies the dharma to everyday questions of love, creativity and fear. Her many books include Start Here Now, The Four Noble Truths of Love, The Buddhist Enneagram and How Not to Be Afraid of Your Own Life, and her recent Buddhism Beyond Belief series, which began with Inexplicable Joy on the Heart Sutra, now includes Inexplicable Magic. Through the sangha she leads a weekly dharma gathering and online retreats, alongside daily live sittings with other teachers, and she also hosts writing and meditation retreats in person and a podcast.

books.title: Start Here Now: An Open-Hearted Guide to the Path and Practice of Meditation
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: A beginner's handbook to sitting meditation, covering posture, working with thoughts and how to keep going, set within the wider Buddhist view of the path.

books.title: Inexplicable Magic: Meditation for Mystics
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: Explores seven principles of spiritual practice and how they can turn ordinary life, from housework to relationships and money, into ground for awakening. Part of her Buddhism Beyond Belief series.

books.title: Inexplicable Joy: On the Heart Sutra
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: A short, readable commentary on the Heart Sutra, one of the best-known texts of Mahayana Buddhism, opening its teaching on emptiness for modern practitioners.

books.title: The Four Noble Truths of Love: Buddhist Wisdom for Modern Relationships
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: Applies the Buddha's first teaching to partnership, suggesting that accepting the shifting nature of a relationship is what lets it stay alive.

books.title: The Buddhist Enneagram: Nine Paths to Warriorship
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: Brings together the Enneagram personality types and Tibetan Buddhist teachings, showing how each type's habits can become a doorway to wisdom.

books.title: How Not to Be Afraid of Your Own Life
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: An early book that uses meditation and Buddhist ideas to help readers meet uncertainty with an open heart instead of bracing against it.

books.title: The Hard Questions: 100 Essential Questions to Ask Before You Say "I Do"
books.author: Susan Piver
books.description: A set of searching questions for couples to work through together before committing, on everything from money and home to sex, work and faith.

courses.title: Open Heart Project Sangha
courses.description: Her online meditation community: daily live sittings with Buddhist teachers, a weekly dharma gathering with Susan, a library of recorded practices and talks, peer practice groups and most online retreats included.

courses.title: Fearless Creativity: A Writing and Meditation Retreat
courses.description: An in-person retreat with Susan at Drala Mountain Center in the Colorado Rockies, giving unbroken time to write and meditate in a supportive group. Bring a project or just the wish to write.

free_resources.title: How to Set Up a Home Meditation Practice
free_resources.description: A free guide, sent by email, to setting up a simple and lasting meditation routine at home.

free_resources.title: The Three Biggest Meditation Misconceptions
free_resources.description: A free short guide clearing up common misunderstandings that make people give up on meditation.

free_resources.title: Meditation and Writing Retreat Weekend at Home
free_resources.description: A free plan for a self-led weekend at home that alternates sitting practice with writing time.

free_resources.title: Buddhism Beyond Belief with Susan Piver (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her podcast on Buddhist teachings and practice as a living spiritual path.
